name: CVR AI Voice TTS
author: LensError
description:
Adds AI-powered TTS modules to ChilloutVR that send your chat messages to an OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint instead of the built-in Windows voice. Supports Kokoro, Morpheus, OpenAI, and any custom OpenAI-compatible server. Audio is requested as 16-bit PCM at 24 kHz and plays through the game's normal TTS path.

Supported backends:
- Kokoro (default: http://localhost:8880)
- Morpheus (default: http://localhost:5005)
- OpenAI (https://api.openai.com)
- Custom — any URL you specify

Settings via Quick Menu: backend picker, base URL, API key, model name, voice preset, custom voice override, and speech speed (0.25–4.0). The active module is selected in CVR audio settings alongside the built-in voice.

Requires a running OpenAI-compatible TTS server or an OpenAI API key. API key and base URL are stored in UserData/MelonPreferences.cfg.
